name: direction-provider
title: Direction provider
description: Sets the reading direction (ltr or rtl) once for every Radix-based component below it.
a11y: Arrow keys follow the reading direction: in rtl, ArrowLeft moves to the next tab, slider step up or toolbar item.
Pair it with a dir attribute on html so the stylesheet mirrors layout too.

props.name: dir
props.description: Reading direction for everything below: `ltr` or `rtl`.

props.name: children
props.description: The part of the app that should use this direction.

usage:
import {DirectionProvider, Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger} from '@monoline/react';
